request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for creating a Nebius Cloud integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create a Nebius Cloud integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the Nebius Cloud integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=nebius_service_account>

object

Service-account key pair authentication, the only method Nebius Cloud integration accounts support. Create a service account in the Nebius console, add it to the admin group, upload an authorized key pair to it, and issue a static API key with the OBSERVABILITY scope through the Nebius CLI.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: nebius_service_account

default: nebius_service_account

private_key

string

The private key of the authorized key pair, in PEM format. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a 422 response.

public_key_id

string

ID of the public key half of the authorized key pair, such as publickey-xxxxxxxx. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a 422 response.

service_account_id [required]

string

Non-secret ID of the Nebius service account the account authenticates as.

static_api_key

string

Nebius static API key with the OBSERVABILITY scope, used to query logs. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a 422 response.

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from Nebius Cloud, keyed by dataflow id. Each dataflow turns on a distinct kind of collection: set enabled to stop or start it, and use settings to configure what it collects. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted fields keep their current values. Every dataflow except nebius-cloud-cost-collection runs as the service account in authentication, using its authorized key pair and the static API key; enabling one of them without those keys is rejected with a 422 response, and one enabled with keys that later expire is stored but collects no data.

nebius-cloud-cost-collection

object

Cloud cost data read from a Nebius Object Storage bucket export and used by Cloud Cost Management. Enabling it requires a bucket holding your cost export and a Nebius access key pair that can read it; a request that enables this dataflow without them is rejected with a 422 response.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

settings

object

Settings of the Cloud Cost Management dataflow. Only the fields provided are changed.

access_key_id

string

ID of the Nebius Object Storage (S3-compatible) access key used to read the cost export bucket. Required when this dataflow is enabled.

access_key_secret

string

Secret access key for the access key ID. Required when this dataflow is enabled. Omit it on update to keep the stored one; an empty string is rejected with a 422 response.

bucket_name

string

Name of the Nebius Object Storage bucket holding your cost export. Required when this dataflow is enabled; a request that enables it without the bucket fields and access keys is rejected with a 422 response.

bucket_prefix_path

string

Prefix path within the bucket that locates the cost export, combining the export name and path prefix.

bucket_region

string

Region of the Nebius Object Storage bucket, such as eu-north1. Required when this dataflow is enabled.

nebius-cloud-logs

object

Logs from your Nebius tenant: Kubernetes control plane and audit logs, tenant-level audit events, compute serial console logs, cloud apps and AI inference logs, PostgreSQL logs, and MLflow logs, collected from the services named in settings.enabled_services. enabled_services is the sole source of truth for what is collected; enabled set to false stops log collection, while true on its own changes nothing. Defaults to no services.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects logs. Defaults to false. Set to false to stop log collection; sending true on its own changes nothing, because settings.enabled_services is the sole source of truth.

settings

object

Settings of the logs dataflow. Only the fields provided are changed.

enabled_services

[string]

Nebius log integrations to collect. One of nebius-cloud-compute, nebius-cloud-kubernetes, nebius-cloud-mlflow, nebius-cloud-postgresql, nebius-cloud-applications, or default for the streams shared by every service. A non-empty list is the sole source of truth and replaces the stored list: those services are collected and any others stop. An empty list stops log collection entirely. Omit it to keep the stored list.

nebius-cloud-resources

object

Metadata about resources in your Nebius tenant, such as compute instances and Kubernetes clusters.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

nebius-cloud-service-quota-collection

object

Usage metrics tracked against your Nebius service quotas, such as nebius_cloud.servicequota.percentage_used and nebius_cloud.servicequota.limit.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the Nebius Cloud integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the Nebius Cloud integration account.

account_tags

[string]

Tags applied to all metrics, logs, and resources collected from this Nebius Cloud account. Defaults to no tags.

tenant_id [required]

string

ID of the Nebius tenant to monitor, the organizational workspace identifier. Found in the Nebius console under Administration > Organization.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

Data envelope for updating a Nebius Cloud integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a Nebius Cloud integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow ids included in the request are modified; dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration, as do the settings of an included dataflow that provides only enabled.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the Nebius Cloud integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=nebius_service_account>

object

string

The private key of the authorized key pair, in PEM format. Omit it to keep the stored one; an empty string is rejected with a 422 response.

public_key_id

string

ID of the public key half of the authorized key pair. Omit it to keep the stored public key ID, send null or an empty string to remove it, or send a value to replace it. Removing it is rejected with a 422 response while log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled.

service_account_id

string

Non-secret ID of the Nebius service account the account authenticates as. It cannot be cleared; sending null or an empty string is rejected with a 422 response.

static_api_key

string

Nebius static API key with the OBSERVABILITY scope. Omit it to keep the stored one; an empty string is rejected with a 422 response.
